subject: chemistry
question_text: Sleeping pills are recommended by doctors to the patients suffering from sleeplessness but it is not advisable to take its doses without consultation with the doctor, Why?
answer_text: Most drugs when taken in doses higher than recommended may cause harmful effects and sometimes, may even lead to death. Hence, a doctor should always be consulted before taking any medicine.
final_answer: Therefore, consulting a doctor is essential before taking sleeping pills.
difficulty_reasoning: Requires understanding of drug safety and medical advice.

subject: chemistry
question_text: Why is use of aspartame limited to cold foods and drinks?
answer_text: Aspartame becomes unstable at cooking temperature. This is the reason why its use is limited to cold foods and drinks.
final_answer: Thus, aspartame is not suitable for cooking.
difficulty_reasoning: Requires understanding of the stability of aspartame under heat.

subject: chemistry
question_text: Why do we require artificial sweetening agents?
answer_text: A large number of people are suffering from diseases such as diabetes and obesity. These people cannot take normal sugar i.e., sucrose as it is harmful for them. Therefore, artificial sweetening agents that do not add to the calorie intake of a person are required.
final_answer: Hence, artificial sweeteners are necessary for those who need to limit sugar intake.
difficulty_reasoning: Requires understanding of dietary needs and health issues.

subject: chemistry
question_text: Name a sweetening agent used in the preparation of sweets for a diabetic patient.
answer_text: Artificial sweetening agents such as saccharin, alitame, and aspartame can be used in preparing sweets for diabetic patients.
final_answer: Thus, these sweeteners are suitable for diabetics.
difficulty_reasoning: Direct recall of examples of sweeteners for diabetics.

subject: chemistry
question_text: What problem arises in using alitame as artificial sweetener?
answer_text: Alitame is a high potency sweetener. It is difficult to control the sweetness of food while using alitame as an artificial sweetener.
final_answer: Therefore, controlling sweetness with alitame can be challenging.
difficulty_reasoning: Requires understanding of the properties of alitame.

subject: chemistry
question_text: How are synthetic detergents better than soap?
answer_text: Soaps work in soft water. However, they are not effective in hard water. In contrast, synthetic detergents work both in soft water and hard water. Therefore, synthetic detergents are better than soaps.
final_answer: Thus, synthetic detergents provide better cleaning in various water conditions.
difficulty_reasoning: Requires understanding of the properties of soaps and detergents.

final_answer: Thus, chemotherapy refers to the use of chemicals for therapeutic effects.

subject: chemistry
question_text: Which forces are involved in holding the drugs to the active site of enzymes?
answer_text: Either of the following forces can be involved in holding drugs to the active sites of enzymes: (i) Ionic bonding (ii) Hydrogen bonding (iii) Dipole - dipole interaction (iv) van der Waals force.
final_answer: Thus, various types of bonding forces are involved in drug-enzyme interactions.

subject: chemistry
question_text: While antacids and antiallergic drugs interfere with the function of histamines, why do these not interfere with the function of each other?
answer_text: Specific drugs affect particular receptors. Antacids and anti-allergic drugs work on different receptors. This is the reason why antacids and anti-allergic drugs do not interfere with each other's functions, but interfere with the functions of histamines.
final_answer: Therefore, the lack of interference is due to the specificity of drug-receptor interactions.
difficulty_reasoning: Requires understanding of drug specificity and receptor interactions.

subject: chemistry
question_text: Low level of noradrenaline is the cause of depression. What types of drugs are needed to cure this problem? Name two drugs.
answer_text: Anti-depressant drugs are needed to counteract the effect of depression. Two anti-depressant drugs are: (i) Iproniazid (ii) Phenelzine.
final_answer: Thus, anti-depressant drugs like Iproniazid and Phenelzine are used to treat depression.
difficulty_reasoning: Requires knowledge of pharmacology and specific drug names.

subject: chemistry
question_text: What is meant by the term 'broad spectrum antibiotics'? Explain.

question_image.description: Diagram illustrating the effectiveness of broad spectrum antibiotics against various bacteria.

answer_text: Antibiotics that are effective against a wide range of gram-positive and gram-negative bacteria are known as broad spectrum antibiotics. Chloramphenicol is a broad spectrum antibiotic. It can be used for the treatment of typhoid, dysentery, acute fever, pneumonia, meningitis, and certain forms of urinary infections. Two other broad spectrum antibiotics are vancomycin and ofloxacin.
final_answer: Therefore, broad spectrum antibiotics are effective against a wide range of bacteria.
difficulty_reasoning: Requires understanding of antibiotic classifications and their applications.

subject: chemistry
question_text: How do antiseptics differ from disinfectants? Give one example of each.
answer_text: Antiseptics are applied to living tissues such as wounds, while disinfectants are applied to inanimate objects. Iodine is an example of a strong antiseptic, and 1 percent solution of phenol is used as a disinfectant.
final_answer: Thus, antiseptics and disinfectants serve different purposes in hygiene.
difficulty_reasoning: Requires understanding of the applications of antiseptics and disinfectants.

subject: chemistry
question_text: Name a substance which can be used as an antiseptic as well as disinfectant.
answer_text: Phenol can be used as an antiseptic as well as a disinfectant. 0.2 percent solution of phenol is used as an antiseptic, while 1 percent of its solution is used as a disinfectant.
final_answer: Thus, phenol serves dual purposes in medical applications.
difficulty_reasoning: Requires knowledge of chemical applications in medicine.

subject: chemistry
question_text: What are the main constituents of dettol?
answer_text: The main constituents of dettol are chloroxylenol and α-terpineol.
final_answer: Thus, chloroxylenol and α-terpineol are key components of dettol.

subject: chemistry
question_text: Can you use soaps and synthetic detergents to check the hardness of water?
answer_text: Soaps get precipitated in hard water, but not in soft water. Therefore, soaps can be used for checking the hardness of water. However, synthetic detergents do not get precipitated either in hard water or in soft water. Therefore, synthetic detergents cannot be used for checking the hardness of water.
final_answer: Thus, soaps can be used to check hardness, while synthetic detergents cannot.
difficulty_reasoning: Requires understanding of soap and detergent chemistry.

subject: chemistry
question_text: Explain the cleansing action of soaps.
answer_text: Soap molecules form micelles around an oil droplet (dirt) in such a way that the hydrophobic parts of the stearate ions attach themselves to the oil droplet and the hydrophilic parts project outside the oil droplet. Due to the polar nature of the hydrophilic parts, the stearate ions (along with the dirt) are pulled into water, thereby removing the dirt from the cloth.
final_answer: Therefore, soaps effectively remove dirt by forming micelles.
difficulty_reasoning: Involves understanding of micelle formation and soap chemistry.

subject: chemistry
question_text: If water contains dissolved calcium hydrogen carbonate, out of soaps and synthetic detergents which one will you use for cleaning clothes?
answer_text: Synthetic detergents are preferred for cleaning clothes. When soaps are dissolved in water containing calcium ions, these ions form insoluble salts that are of no further use. However, when synthetic detergents are dissolved in water containing calcium ions, these ions form soluble salts that act as cleansing agents.
final_answer: Thus, synthetic detergents are more effective in hard water conditions.
difficulty_reasoning: Requires understanding of the interaction between soaps, detergents, and calcium ions.
